models_evaluated: OMOM Artificial Intelligence-enabled small bowel capsule

links.outcome: Lesion capture and reading time with AI-assisted versus standard capsule reading by the same studies
links.effect: AI-assisted reading captured 98.1% of significant lesion images vs 86.2% for standard reading (P<0.001); mean reading time fell from 29.7 to 2.3 minutes; overall diagnosis agreed 100%.
links.quote: AI-assisted reading has shown significant time savings without reducing sensitivity in this study.

screen.reason: Retrospective comparative reader study evaluating the impact of AI-assisted reading versus standard human reading on reading time and lesion identification in capsule endoscopy.
